title: Zap Catalogue — visual world
question: Pick the world for Zap’s Catalogue redesign. Layout can change; features stay.

options.label: Lacquer Spine Wall
options.thesis: Catalogue as a lit spine wall: dark lacquer ground, tracks as tight spines, play actions sized like a remote.
options.viewport: Top chrome: Zap + nav. Filters as a slim tuner strip. Main stage: dense track rows like album spines; playing row glows as one lit LED. Add music is a remote-sized primary.
options.risk: Can feel too quiet/hi-fi if the signal glow is timid — hangouts need punch.

raised.raise: One grotesque family only — hierarchy is size and weight, never a second display costume.
Every track row shares one fixed scale and baseline rhythm so the list registers like plates.
Content hangs off one off-centre rail; selection state speaks in weight and edge, not rainbow chrome.

options.label: Karaoke Songbook
options.thesis: Find-and-fire: numbered dense titles, artist under, one huge Play gesture.
options.viewport: Full-width search + scope tabs. Numbered track table dominates. Play/enqueue sit on every row like songbook picks.
options.risk: Most familiar music-UI landing — strong, but the category’s safe harbour.

options.label: Event Catalog Grid
options.lineage: convention circle catalog / doujin hall grid
options.thesis: Hundreds of tracks as whole cells in a packed grid — mark, route, enqueue like circling tables on a hall map.
options.viewport: Slim side rail for Zap nav. Filters collapse to a sticky strip. Main: responsive track cards in a dense grid; active/queued cells ringed in spot color.
options.case: Wins audience ID (browsing a packed catalogue) and product clarity (Catalogue is literally a catalog).
options.risk: Grid density can crush metadata if cells are too small — titles must stay readable.

options.label: Gate Board
options.thesis: Tracks as ranked board rows; playing/queued changes stay lit until you notice.
options.viewport: Top nav. Filter segments like a pass. Track board columns: title, tags, duration, action — playing row holds amber until acknowledged.
options.case: Holds product clarity (live state, identity-preserving updates); loses slightly on hangout identification.
options.risk: Can read airport-cold without a warm signal accent.

options.label: FAC Pulse Sleeve
options.thesis: Matte black field, sparse type, tags as color code strips; the active track alone blooms full color.
options.viewport: Minimal top mark. Filters as coded chips. List of tracks with tiny FAC-like ids; selected spine expands color; play is a single white control.
options.case: Strong music-culture identification; clarity costs if titles hide behind codes.
options.risk: Too cryptic for fast hangout enqueue if decoding is mandatory.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Loses both axes for Operate — pixel display hurts scannable catalogue text.
options.kept: Specimen hierarchy: one face, many sizes.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Loses both — cream/editorial fights the dark vibrant brief.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.case: Loses both — instrument costume risk on a working Operate screen.
options.kept: Off-centre rail + state in line weight.

canonCard.label: Category standard music app
canonCard.thesis: Dark Spotify-like shell: top nav, search bar, list rows with play — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar music-app catalogue: search, filters, scrollable track list with play buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other music tool by design.
